title: General.
officialText: Geotechnical investigations shall be subject to special inspections in accordance with Sections 1704.7, 1704.8 and 1704.9 and be conducted in conformance with Sections 1802.2 through 1802.7. An engineer shall scope, supervise and approve the subsurface investigation and the classification of the soil and rock encountered.
